temporal-resolution-hearing.基于 Web Audio 的实验性听觉测试。包含「间隙检测」（两段白噪声间插入可: An experimental Web Audio hearing test. It includes Gap Detection (a silent gap inserted between two noise bursts — decide if you can hear the break) and Modulation Detection (amplitude modulation over a carrier — decide if you can hear the fluctuation), both using a 2-IFC adaptive staircase to estimate millisecond thresholds, with references for children / youth / older adults. Use headphones in a quiet environment.

temporal-resolution-hearing.听觉时间分辨率指听觉系统分辨快速时间结构变化的能力。间隙检测（Gap Detec: Auditory temporal resolution is the ability to resolve rapid temporal changes. Gap Detection Threshold (GDT) reflects sensitivity to brief silences; Amplitude Modulation Detection (AMD) reflects tracking of loudness fluctuations. Both decline with age and relate to central auditory processing. This page approximates thresholds with a 2-IFC adaptive staircase (narrow the stimulus on a hit, widen on a miss; average the last reversal points).

pure-tone-audiometry.纯前端 Web Audio 工具：用 AudioContext 生成 125 /: A pure front-end Web Audio tool: an AudioContext generates 8 pure tones (125 / 250 / 500 / 1000 / 2000 / 4000 / 8000 Hz, sine waves with adjustable duration and volume). Each ear is tested with an ascending method to estimate the hearing threshold, and a standard audiogram is drawn automatically (log-frequency axis × dB axis, with normal / mild / moderate / severe / profound bands per WHO grading). Use headphones in a quiet environment.

pure-tone-audiometry.纯音测听（Pure-Tone Audiometry）是听力学的金标准筛查手段，记: Pure-Tone Audiometry is the gold-standard screening in audiology, recording the minimum audible sound pressure at each frequency — the threshold (dB HL). Clinically, the mean of 500 / 1000 / 2000 / 4000 Hz (PTA) gives the WHO grade: normal ≤25, mild 26–40, moderate 41–60, severe 61–80, profound >80 dB HL. This page approximates tones via Web Audio with an ascending threshold estimate — for fun and education only.
